wiringInterpretation.rationale: Plan_final 11-008 exposes the deterministic audio-hash windows for the acceptance gates via one src/vanilla facade (wireAudioHashWindows.ts) re-exporting the read-only src/audio/audioParity.ts harness (per-tic deterministic SFX/mixer/music + hashPcmBuffer 64-char uppercase-hex SHA-256, runHarnessTic, toAudioHashEntry, HARNESS_TIC_RATE_HZ 35 / HARNESS_SHA256_HEX_LENGTH 64) and src/oracles/musicEventLog.ts (MUSIC_EVENT_KINDS change/pause/resume/stop, frozen EMPTY title-loop/demo-playback baselines, MUS_MAX_CHANNELS 16 / percussion 15 / MIDI 9, music volume [0,15]). VANILLA_AUDIO_HASH_WINDOW_INVARIANTS pins the five rules. The focused test exercises the real harness (hashPcmBuffer determinism + uppercase-hex format corrected to match the authoritative read-only source, createAudioParityHarness integer-samples-per-tic guard, frozen event-kind/empty-log baselines), the multi-line-tolerant ../-filtered specifier set, and dynamic same-reference identity, keeping the test inventory-neutral. No const enums re-exported (verbatimModuleSyntax). audioParity src importer count reconciled 0->1 (musicEventLog in src/oracles is not importer-tracked).
